# Bob The Tech Guy

> Veteran-owned computer repair, virus removal and networking for homes and small businesses. Founded in 2006 by Bob Dyer, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran with 25 years of hands-on IT experience. Serves Chesterfield and the greater Richmond area in Virginia, and northern New Jersey. On-site service.

- Owner: Bob Dyer (Bob The Tech Guy), U.S. Marine Corps veteran; veteran-owned and operated
- Virginia (Chesterfield and greater Richmond): 844-TEKGUY-0 (844-835-4890)
- Northern New Jersey: (862) 210-5656
- Email: info@bobthetechguy.com
- Hours (Eastern Time): Tuesday 9:30 AM-7 PM; Wednesday to Friday 9:30 AM-5 PM; Saturday 12-3 PM; closed Sunday and Monday
- Virginia towns served: Chesterfield, Midlothian, Chester, Bon Air, Brandermill, Woodlake, Moseley, Colonial Heights, Richmond
- New Jersey towns served: Pompton Lakes, Wayne, Wyckoff, Ramsey, Mahwah, Oakland, Allendale, Upper Saddle River, Saddle River, Waldwick, Midland Park, Ridgewood, Glen Rock, Fair Lawn, Paramus, Riverdale, Butler, Wanaque, Pequannock, Montville, Totowa (Bergen and Passaic counties)

## Services: repairs and upgrades

- [Hardware Repair & Upgrades](https://bobthetechguy.com/hardware-repair-upgrades/): diagnostics, failed parts replaced, and upgrades for older PCs
- [Screen Replacement](https://bobthetechguy.com/screen-replacement/): cracked or dead laptop screens replaced and tested
- [Memory Install](https://bobthetechguy.com/memory-install/): RAM upgrades, installed and tested
- [Hardware Install](https://bobthetechguy.com/hardware-install/): graphics cards, drives, power supplies, webcams and more, installed and tested
- [Computer Tune Up](https://bobthetechguy.com/computer-tune-up/): slow computers cleaned up and updated
- [Data Recovery Service](https://bobthetechguy.com/data-recovery-service/): photos, documents and files recovered from damaged or failed drives

## Services: setup and software

- [Computer Set Up](https://bobthetechguy.com/computer-set-up/): new computers set up with updates, accounts, email, Microsoft Office and printers
- [Operating System Install](https://bobthetechguy.com/operating-system-install/): Windows, Mac OS and Linux installs and reinstalls
- [Software Installation and Configuration](https://bobthetechguy.com/software-installation-and-configuration/): Microsoft Office, security tools, drivers and business programs
- [Printer Solutions](https://bobthetechguy.com/printer-solutions/): wired and wireless printer and scanner setup and troubleshooting
- [Email Setup](https://bobthetechguy.com/email-setup/): Outlook, Gmail and business email accounts configured
- [Remote Support](https://bobthetechguy.com/remote-support/): Bob connects to your computer over the internet and fixes the problem remotely

## Services: security and networking

- [Networking](https://bobthetechguy.com/networking/): home and small-business Wi-Fi, wired networks and routers
- [Anti-Virus](https://bobthetechguy.com/anti-virus/): virus, spyware and malware removal, plus current protection
- [Backup Solutions](https://bobthetechguy.com/backup-solutions/): automatic local and cloud backups
